Definition: to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bow down; 1a) (Qal) to bow down; 1b)(Hiphil) to depress (fig); 1c) (Hithpael); 1c1) to bow down, prostrate oneself; 1c1a) before superior in homage; 1c1b) before God in worship; 1c1c) before false gods; 1c1d) before angel
